note: Review criteria for this teaching scenario; they mirror the nucsci domain gates.

criticality.rule: upper >= usl blocks; review_threshold <= upper < usl needs engineer review

burnup_pairing.rule: burnup >= 45 requires both decay-heat and shielding analyses; 40 <= burnup < 45 is a warning

sar_draft.rule: generate_sar_section must succeed with the package's sar_request exactly as written; a refusal for a missing benchmark reference is a failed benchmark gate
